CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "image_url" character varying(2048),
  "name" character varying(140) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "category_identity_valid_04da0bf4" CHECK ("slug" = lower(btrim("slug")) AND char_length(btrim("name")) > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customers" (
  "address_line_1" character varying(240),
  "address_line_2" character varying(240),
  "city" character varying(120),
  "commune" character varying(120),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "email_normalized" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "first_name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "last_name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(40),
  "region" character varying(120),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "tax_id" character varying(40),

  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),

  CONSTRAINT "customers_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."idempotency_records" (
  "actor_user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "key_hash" bytea NOT NULL,
  "operation" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "original_request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" bytea NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" uuid,
  "resource_type" character varying(120),
  "response_json" json,
  "response_status" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "idempotency_record_state_valid_f259233a" CHECK (octet_length("key_hash") = 32 AND octet_length("request_hash") = 32 AND "expires_at" > "created_at" AND (("status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "response_status" IS NULL AND "response_json" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "response_status" BETWEEN 200 AND 599 AND "response_json" IS NOT NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "idempotency_records_status_check_d33d8563" CHECK ("status" IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_balances" (
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lot_id" uuid,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "physical_quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reserved_quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_balance_quantities_valid_9a742e1c" CHECK ("physical_quantity" >= 0 AND "reserved_quantity" >= 0 AND "reserved_quantity" <= "physical_quantity")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_locations" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_location_identity_valid_ec05107c" CHECK (char_length(btrim("name")) > 0 AND char_length(btrim("code")) > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_lots" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiration_date" date,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "lot_number" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_lot_number_valid_9da413c9" CHECK (char_length(btrim("lot_number")) > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_movements" (
  "actor_user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "balance_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lot_id" uuid,
  "new_physical_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "previous_physical_quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity_delta" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(240),
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_movement_quantities_valid_c6f6647e" CHECK ("quantity_delta" <> 0 AND "previous_physical_quantity" >= 0 AND "new_physical_quantity" >= 0 AND "new_physical_quantity" = "previous_physical_quantity" + "quantity_delta"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_movements_type_check_4666765d" CHECK ("type" IN ('PURCHASE_RECEIPT', 'SALE', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'RETURN', 'DAMAGE', 'EXPIRED', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'TRANSFER_OUT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_reservations" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lot_id" uuid,
  "order_id" uuid,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_reservation_values_valid_02fd4e0e" CHECK ("quantity" > 0 AND "expires_at" > "created_at"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_reservations_status_check_e4d0c47e" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONSUMED', 'RELEASED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."memberships" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "memberships_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_items" (
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "line_total" int4 NOT NULL,
  "order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_name_snapshot" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sku_snapshot" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_item_amounts_valid_14a13d1e" CHECK ("unit_price" >= 0 AND "quantity" > 0 AND "line_total" = "unit_price" * "quantity")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_status_events" (
  "actor_user_id" uuid,
  "from_status" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "occurred_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(500),
  "to_status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_event_transition_valid_ba42e96a" CHECK ("from_status" IS NULL OR "from_status" <> "to_status"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_events_from_status_check_e7581e6b" CHECK ("from_status" IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_events_to_status_check_66c24f4b" CHECK ("to_status" IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "discount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "estimated_ready_at" timestamptz(3),
  "fulfillment_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "order_number" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "payment_status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "shipping" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING_PAYMENT' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_amounts_valid_1e7b8002" CHECK ("subtotal" >= 0 AND "discount" >= 0 AND "shipping" >= 0 AND "discount" <= "subtotal" AND "total" = "subtotal" - "discount" + "shipping"),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_fulfillment_type_check_53d49a0e" CHECK ("fulfillment_type" IN ('PICKUP', 'DELIVERY')),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_payment_status_check_c585b9b6" CHECK ("payment_status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'REFUNDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_status_check_ed5ae3a5" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization_settings" (
  "contact_email" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "contact_phone" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiration_warning_days" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "low_stock_threshold" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "package_alert_days" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "pickup_address" character varying(300) NOT NULL,
  "pickup_instructions" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("organization_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organization_settings_thresholds_valid_632a79df" CHECK ("low_stock_threshold" >= 0 AND "package_alert_days" >= 0 AND "expiration_warning_days" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organizations" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'CLP' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "locale" character varying(20) DEFAULT 'es-CL' NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(80) DEFAULT 'America/Santiago' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organization_identity_valid_4075c65a" CHECK (char_length(btrim("name")) > 0 AND "slug" = lower(btrim("slug")) AND char_length("currency") = 3)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."package_pickup_receipts" (
  "delivered_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "delivered_by_user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "package_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pickup_code_verified" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "received_by" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "package_pickup_receipt_values_valid_5a3042a3" CHECK (char_length(btrim("received_by")) > 0 AND "pickup_code_verified")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."packages" (
  "carrier" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "item_count" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "order_id" uuid,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "picked_up_at" timestamptz(3),
  "pickup_code_consumed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "pickup_code_hash" bytea,
  "pickup_deadline" timestamptz(3),
  "ready_at" timestamptz(3),
  "received_at" timestamptz(3),
  "received_by_user_id" uuid,
  "requires_cold_storage" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'EXPECTED' NOT NULL,
  "storage_location_id" uuid,
  "stored_at" timestamptz(3),
  "tracking_code" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "weight_kg" numeric,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "package_values_valid_0542a9ca" CHECK (char_length(btrim("tracking_code")) > 0 AND char_length(btrim("carrier")) > 0 AND "item_count" > 0 AND ("weight_kg" IS NULL OR "weight_kg" > 0) AND ("pickup_code_hash" IS NULL OR octet_length("pickup_code_hash") = 32)),
  CONSTRAINT "packages_status_check_d678021e" CHECK ("status" IN ('EXPECTED', 'RECEIVED', 'STORED', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'PICKED_UP', 'RETURNED', 'LOST', 'INCIDENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(240),
  "key" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key"),
  CONSTRAINT "permission_key_valid_9279437e" CHECK ("key" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "barcode" character varying(100),
  "brand" character varying(160),
  "category_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "image_url" character varying(2048),
  "minimum_stock" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "published" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sale_price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sku" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "product_values_valid_f4c0e225" CHECK (char_length(btrim("sku")) > 0 AND "slug" = lower(btrim("slug")) AND char_length(btrim("name")) > 0 AND "sale_price" >= 0 AND "minimum_stock" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rate_limit_buckets" (
  "blocked_until" timestamptz(3),
  "count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "key_hash" bytea NOT NULL,
  "scope" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "window_started_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rate_limit_bucket_values_valid_a963acaf" CHECK (char_length(btrim("scope")) > 0 AND octet_length("key_hash") = 32 AND "count" >= 0 AND "expires_at" >= "window_started_at")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role_permissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "permission_key" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "role_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "role_permission_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("organization_id", "role_id", "permission_key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "code" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "label" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "system" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "role_identity_valid_4f14adb4" CHECK (char_length(btrim("code")) > 0 AND char_length(btrim("label")) > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessions" (
  "audience" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" uuid,
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "last_seen_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "membership_id" uuid,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revocation_reason" character varying(160),
  "revoked_at" timestamptz(3),
  "token_hash" bytea NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "session_context_valid_dc975831" CHECK (octet_length("token_hash") = 32 AND "expires_at" > "created_at" AND (("audience" = 'STAFF' AND "membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_id" IS NULL) OR ("audience" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "membership_id" IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "sessions_audience_check_de2a3de6" CHECK ("audience" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'STAFF'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tracking_events" (
  "actor_user_id" uuid,
  "description" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "location" character varying(240),
  "new_status" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "occurred_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "package_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "previous_status" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tracking_event_values_valid_f46d30bb" CHECK (char_length(btrim("description")) > 0 AND ("previous_status" IS NULL OR "previous_status" <> "new_status")),
  CONSTRAINT "tracking_events_new_status_check_3a705eef" CHECK ("new_status" IN ('EXPECTED', 'RECEIVED', 'STORED', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'PICKED_UP', 'RETURNED', 'LOST', 'INCIDENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "tracking_events_previous_status_check_a1498358" CHECK ("previous_status" IN ('EXPECTED', 'RECEIVED', 'STORED', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'PICKED_UP', 'RETURNED', 'LOST', 'INCIDENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "email_normalized" character varying(320) NOT NULL,
  "email_verified_at" timestamptz(3),
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(512) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_identity_valid_962ac172" CHECK ("email_normalized" = lower(btrim("email_normalized")) AND char_length("password_hash") > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)
